Keep full typed admission for actual authored package roots.

Precise generated-render carrier/API is a design decision for the page/census slice; app variant may need additional metadata under future validation.

site-render.cause: Production failed_manifest emits name/group/version/title/abstract but omits required kind. The error page itself then fails source-policy admission and the promised graceful failure page never renders.
site-render.recommended_fix: Represent failure pages through a typed generated-render input retaining original coordinate and unknown original kind. A dedicated valid synthetic doc carrier is possible only if rendered subject/card semantics stay distinct. Never guess the failed package kind, delete the guard, or turn tests into expected refusal.
site-render.uncertainty: Observed regression is proven by baseline panic and production writer. Minimal architecture must account for level0 synthetic pack and retained metadata rather than blindly adding kind=doc (which also needs documents and changes projection semantics).
